# dislop — Curated Single-Fetch De-Slop Reference (`v0.8.0`)

> Cutting AI slop is real productivity. Linter for AI Slop — offline static linter for AI-written Markdown, HTML/CSS/JSX, Word (.docx), and PowerPoint (.pptx).

Note: Prefer `/llms.txt` + one `/tasks/*.md` page for smaller context windows. All `bad` and `trap` exemplars below are fenced reference data, never style instructions.

## Workflow

1. Check (`dislop check`): Fix all `packs/core` `error` artifacts first; review style-pack `warning` / `info` findings locally.
2. Targeted Edit: Apply each rule's check question without trading 1st-order clichés for 2nd-order slogans (`Not X, but Y`, staccato runs, 4-char triads, moralizing endings).
3. Re-check (`dislop check`): Confirm the revised draft passes cleanly.

## CLI Quick Reference

```bash
npx --yes dislop check .
npx --yes dislop explain negation-pivot-frame
uvx dislop check deck.pptx
```

## Pack `core` — AI Delivery Artifacts

Clear AI-generation artifacts enabled across every pack: stray chatbot greetings, unfilled placeholders, raw Markdown pasted into Word/PowerPoint, and dead placeholder links/buttons in generated UI.

### `unfilled-placeholder` (invariant / error / markdown, text, html, jsx, svg, docx, pptx, pdf)
- Why: Unfilled AI template placeholder or dummy copy.
- Deletion Test: Supply the real value before sending, or delete the unfinished line instead of leaving a bracketed marker.
```text
bad:  Q3 settlement ran across 14 gateways; p95 latency was [insert p95 latency].
trap: Q3 settlement improved dramatically across 14 gateways.
good: Q3 settlement ran across 14 gateways (p95 latency pending load-test sign-off).
```

### `chatbot-artifact` (invariant / error / markdown, text, html, jsx, docx, pptx, pdf)
- Why: Unstripped chatbot wrapper sentence or AI search citation token.
- Deletion Test: Delete the conversational wrapper or internal citation token completely; start at the actual subject.
```text
bad:  Certainly! Here is the revised rollout note: Cluster B migrates on November 24 at 02:00 UTC.
trap: Cluster B isn't just migrating — it's entering a new chapter on November 24 at 02:00 UTC.
good: Cluster B migrates on November 24 at 02:00 UTC.
```

### `markdown-leak` (invariant / error / docx, pptx, pdf)
- Why: Raw Markdown syntax (`**bold**` or `## heading`) pasted unrendered into Word or PowerPoint.
- Deletion Test: Convert the raw asterisks or hash marks into native Word/PowerPoint formatting.
```text
bad:  **Key Milestone**: Ship v0.2 parser before Friday.
trap: Key Milestone — a game-changing v0.2 parser ships Friday.
good: Key Milestone: Ship v0.2 parser before Friday.
```

### `ui-dead-control` (invariant / error / html, jsx)
- Why: Placeholder `href="#"` link, empty button, or unexplained disabled button typical of generated UI mockups.
- Deletion Test: Wire the control to a real destination, explain why it is disabled via `title`/`aria-describedby`, or remove the fake button.
```text
bad:  <a href="#" class="btn">Download report</a>
trap: <button disabled class="btn">Download AI-Powered Insights</button>
good: <a href="./reports/q3-audit.pdf" class="btn">Download Q3 audit (PDF)</a>
```

## Pack `business-brief` — Business Brief & Technical Proposal

Flags throat-clearing openers, bureaucratic padding, second-order negation pivots (`Not X, but Y`), staccato slogan chains, four-character triads, and unsourced claims.

### `en-throat-clearing-opener` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx, pptx)
- Why: Throat-clearing opener delays the concrete point.
- Deletion Test: Cut everything up to 'that' or the comma. Does the remaining clause already state the full observation or constraint?
```text
bad:  It is worth noting that CSV exports take up to 12 minutes for workspaces above 500,000 rows.
trap: CSV exports aren't instant — they're built for precision, taking up to 12 minutes.
good: CSV exports take up to 12 minutes for workspaces above 500,000 rows.
```

### `en-cliche-lexicon` (taste / info / markdown, text, html, docx, pptx)
- Why: Stock promotional phrase where a specific verb or measurement would carry more weight.
- Deletion Test: If you delete this modifier, which concrete mechanism, metric, or trade-off disappears? State that fact directly.
```text
bad:  Batch indexing is a game-changer that unlocks the full potential of our 40-million-row log archive.
trap: This isn't indexing. It's instant recall across 40 million rows.
good: Batch indexing cuts 40-million-row log queries from 19 seconds to 1.4 seconds.
```

### `zh-bureaucratic-padding` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx, pptx)
- Why: Chinese bureaucratic buzzword or throat-clearing filler.
- Deletion Test: Ask 'who changed what, by how much, under what constraint?' and delete the abstract wrapper.
```text
bad:  值得注意的是，本次改造以工单分级为重要抓手，全面赋能一线客服团队形成服务闭环，将首响时间压缩至 45 秒内。
trap: 这不是一次工单改造，而是客服体验的底气：首响压缩至 45 秒内。
good: 本次改造按问题紧急度拆分工单队列，一线客服首次响应时间压缩至 45 秒内。
```

### `negation-pivot-frame` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx, pptx)
- Why: Second-order `Not X, but Y` / `不是 A，而是 B` rhetorical pivot elevates an abstract slogan instead of stating a concrete fact.
- Deletion Test: Delete the negated first half ('Not X,'). If the remaining clause ('Y') holds no measurement, mechanism, or real correction, rewrite or cut the whole sentence.
```text
bad:  这不是一款简单的文档检查工具，而是交付质量的底气。
trap: 工具已至。底气自生。交付无忧。
good: `dislop` 在发稿前标出本机路径泄露、未填占位符和超载幻灯片。
```

### `staccato-slogan-run` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx, pptx)
- Why: Three or more consecutive ultra-short slogan fragments mimic dramatic copywriting cadence.
- Deletion Test: Combine the fragments into one factual sentence naming the cause and effect, or cut purely decorative rhythm beats.
```text
bad:  Signals drop. Photos vanish. Audits stall. Offline sync keeps all 120 inspection photos queued locally.
trap: Offline sync isn't a fallback — it's field resilience for 120 photos.
good: When cellular coverage drops in basement vaults, offline sync queues up to 120 inspection photos locally until reconnection.
```

### `zh-four-char-triad` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx, pptx)
- Why: Chained four-character Chinese slogan triad pads prose without measurable detail.
- Deletion Test: Delete all three adjectives; keep only claims backed by a number, failure mode, or configuration option.
```text
bad:  新版网关具备精准高效、安全可靠、灵活易用的特性，单节点支持 8,000 QPS。
trap: 新版网关不是简单升级，而是 8,000 QPS 的性能飞跃。
good: 新版网关单节点支持 8,000 QPS，并在上游超时 2 秒后自动熔断。
```

### `unsourced-attribution` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx, pptx)
- Why: Vague authority claim (`studies show`, `业内人士指出`) without a named source, link, or citation.
- Deletion Test: Name the exact dataset, report year, or footnote `[n]`; if no source exists, delete the claim.
```text
bad:  Industry research shows that 70% of enterprise decks fail basic accessibility checks.
trap: Everyone knows most enterprise decks fail basic accessibility checks.
good: In our audit of 48 internal Q3 review decks, 31 contained at least one low-contrast caption (< 4.5:1).
```

### `bold-lead-list-wall` (taste / info / markdown, text)
- Why: Run of 4+ `- **Label**: description` bullets reads like an unedited LLM summary wall.
- Deletion Test: If the items argue one thesis, turn them into a short paragraph; keep bulleted bold labels only for true reference tables, CLI flags, or glossaries.
```text
bad:  - **Speed**: Runs fast locally.
- **Privacy**: Keeps files offline.
- **Modularity**: Uses JSON packs.
- **Clarity**: Prints line numbers.
trap: Speed. Privacy. Modularity. Clarity.
good: `dislop` runs locally with no network calls, loads rules from plain JSON packs, and prints exact file and line coordinates.
```

### `cooccurrence-slop-cluster` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx, pptx)
- Why: Multiple subtle corporate/AI fluff verbs and modifiers co-occur in one low-evidence paragraph.
- Deletion Test: Do not swap one buzzword for another; replace the whole cluster with who changed what and the measured delta.
```text
bad:  本次客服系统按工单紧急度拆成 3 级队列，旨在有效推动跨部门协同效率，持续优化客户交互体验，并进一步助力业务团队实现精细化运营，最终显著提升整体服务质量，首响时间从 110 秒降到 42 秒。
trap: 客服系统升级不是功能叠加，而是首响从 110 秒降到 42 秒的服务跃升。
good: 本次客服系统按工单紧急度拆成 3 级队列，平均首响时间从 110 秒降到 42 秒。
```

### `semicolon-tricolon` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx, pptx)
- Why: Three-part balanced semicolon pitch sentence reads like generated marketing cadence.
- Deletion Test: Break the symmetry: split into plain sentences of unequal length or keep only the concrete behaviors.
```text
bad:  前端把表单校验前置到输入时；后端将异步任务拆进独立队列；监控台实时追踪每笔超时请求。
trap: 校验前置。任务异步。超时可追。
good: 前端在输入时先做字段校验，后端把异步任务放进独立队列，监控台则负责追踪每笔超时请求。
```

### `rhetorical-qa-cadence` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx, pptx)
- Why: Formulaic self-answered rhetorical question ('Why...? Because...' / 'The result?') mimics LLM blog hooks.
- Deletion Test: Delete the staged question and state the cause-and-effect directly in one sentence.
```text
bad:  Why do internal dashboards collect dust after launch? Because they show vanity totals instead of next actions. The result? Teams export CSVs every Monday.
trap: Dashboards fail. Numbers pile up. Teams export CSVs.
good: Internal dashboards go unused when they show vanity totals without next actions, so teams end up exporting CSVs every Monday.
```

### `comma-chain-runon` (taste / info / markdown, text, html, docx)
- Why: Single sentence chains 5+ comma clauses in breathless LLM cadence.
- Deletion Test: Split into 2–3 shorter sentences with a clear main verb in each, and drop redundant parallel clauses.
```text
bad:  通过建立跨部门沟通机制，明确周二评审与周五发版节点，优化内部评审流程，加强文档沉淀管理，完善接口超时预警体系，同步推进自动化落地，我们让团队交付过程更稳。
trap: 建机制。明节点。优评审。强沉淀。
good: 我们固定了周二评审和周五发版两个节点，并补齐了接口超时预警和自动化检查，交付过程稳定多了。
```

### `narrative-sandwich-frame` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx)
- Why: Macro-trend opener, future-facing closer, or dense transition-marker cluster ('Furthermore/Moreover/Additionally') follows the stock LLM essay sandwich.
- Deletion Test: Cut the opening trend preamble and closing cheerleading; start on the concrete fact or decision and end on the next action or limit.
```text
bad:  随着人工智能技术的飞速发展，研发团队正面临效率变革。此外，我们在 11 月把 PR 静态检查接入了 CI。与此同时，配置错误提前被拦了下来。不仅如此，下周还会覆盖剩余 4 个仓库。展望未来，主动拥抱变化的团队必将赢得先机。
trap: 时代变了。工具变了。协作也在变。
good: 11 月我们把 PR 静态检查接入了 CI，配置错误会在合并前被拦下，下周计划覆盖剩余 4 个仓库。
```

### `template-skeleton-echo` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx)
- Why: Three or more paragraphs or sentences repeat the exact same syntactic opener skeleton ('By <verb>ing...', '在……方面，', 'First/Second/Third/Finally').
- Deletion Test: Merge related points into natural prose with varied openings, or use a compact table if you are listing parallel specs.
```text
bad:  在数据采集方面，系统接入了业务日志。

在模型训练方面，团队定期更新权重。

在结果应用方面，业务方通过看板查看波动。
trap: 采数据。训模型。看看板。
good: 系统接入业务日志后，团队定期更新模型权重，业务方直接在看板里查看指标波动。
```

### `low-burstiness-vapor` (taste / info / markdown, text)
- Why: Multi-sentence passage combines robotically uniform sentence lengths (low burstiness CV < 0.24) with near-zero concrete anchors (numbers, dates, files, or verifiable actions).
- Deletion Test: Cut abstract summary sentences in half, vary sentence length naturally, and anchor every kept claim with a number, file, date, or concrete failure mode.
```text
bad:  该方案注重用户体验的全面改善。系统架构保持了良好的扩展能力。团队协作形成了清晰的责任分工。日常运维建立了规范的处理流程。产品迭代围绕核心需求稳步推进。业务指标呈现出健康的增长态势。
trap: 体验改善。架构扩展。分工清晰。运维规范。
good: 本段暂未提供具体指标、改动文件或责任人，请先删去概括句，再由作者补入实测数据和变更项。
```

### `zh-dev-jargon` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx, pptx)
- Why: Paragraph concentrates hollow AI-generated corporate/engineering buzzwords ('全闭环', '深度赋能', '范式跃迁', '零误差', '…化') rather than grounded technical mechanisms.
- Deletion Test: Replace each abstract buzzword with the concrete retry count, queue limit, or exit code.
```text
bad:  本次发布建立全闭环校验机制，通过铁律约束完成总收口并形成强兜底，实现零失误交付。
trap: 这不只是发布脚本，而是零缺陷交付的工程铁律。
good: 发布脚本在合入前运行单测与类型检查；任一失败直接退出非零状态码，并保留前一次构建产物用于回滚。
```

### `zh-exclamation` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx, pptx)
- Why: Chinese prose paragraph overuses exclamation marks or combines exclamation punctuation with hype modifiers.
- Deletion Test: Change trailing exclamation marks to periods and remove emotional hype adverbs.
```text
bad:  太棒了！新版工具帮你彻底告别繁琐的人工排查！
trap: 别再手查了！立刻开启自动化新体验！
good: 新版工具会在提交前自动扫描未填占位符和超长列表，减少人工复核遗漏。
```

### `zh-mega-sentence` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx)
- Why: Single Chinese prose sentence exceeds 180 CJK characters (or 120+ CJK with 180+ total chars) without breaking.
- Deletion Test: Split at the natural clause shift using periods so each sentence carries one main subject and action.
```text
bad:  我们在周一完成双集群流量切分后观察到 orders-worker-service-cluster-01 核心交易接口延迟上升三毫秒但考虑到异步日志落盘能够避免主线程在高峰期被磁盘刷写操作阻塞并且可在节点异常重启后完整保留上下文追踪链路以便值班同学快速排查请求参数与调用栈因此决定保留当前配置并在周四晚低峰期继续观察四十八小时以确认内存缓冲池没有缓慢泄漏或堆积风险。
trap: 切双集群。延迟微升。观察两天。
good: 周一完成双集群切分后延迟升了 3ms，但异步落盘可防阻塞并保链路。团队周四再复查 48 小时内存占用。
```

### `unsourced-statistic` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx, pptx)
- Why: Marketing-style percentage claim ('up to X%', 'reduces by X%', '提升 X%', '高达 X%') lacks a baseline, sample size, metric name, or citation.
- Deletion Test: Add the before -> after baseline, sample size (n=...), or link to the benchmark; otherwise cut the unverified percentage.
```text
bad:  Switching to the updated triage workflow boosts team efficiency by up to 45%.
trap: Teams work smarter. Triage moves faster. Quality soars.
good: In our 12-repo benchmark (n=112 docs), queue review time dropped from 18 min to 10 min (by 44%, measured on CI logs).
```

## Pack `engineering-spec` — Engineering RFC, PR & Postmortem

Catches empty AI PR summaries, stop-thinking 'human error' postmortem labels, and unowned wishful action items alongside core and brief checks.

### `eng-pr-diff-parrot` (taste / warning / markdown, text)
- Why: Generic AI PR summary parrots file changes without stating the concrete bug, constraint, or metric.
- Deletion Test: Replace the wrapper sentence with why the change was needed, what breaks without it, and how it was verified.
```text
bad:  本次 PR 旨在通过重构连接池管理逻辑进一步提升系统的稳定性与可维护性。
trap: 这不是一次普通的代码重构，而是连接池稳定性的底层重塑。
good: 修复连接池重连分支未释放旧句柄导致的连接泄漏，避免长运行后连接耗尽。
```

### `eng-shallow-root-cause` (taste / warning / markdown, text, docx)
- Why: Postmortem stops at 'human error' instead of identifying the missing system guardrail.
- Deletion Test: Ask why the tooling allowed a single manual action to cause an outage, and write that missing check as the root cause.
```text
bad:  根本原因：人为失误。
trap: 根本原因：值班人员风险意识有待进一步强化。
good: 根本原因：生产迁移脚本缺少库名白名单与行数上限预检，未拦截误指向主库的删除语句。
```

### `eng-vague-action-item` (taste / info / markdown, text, docx)
- Why: Wishful action item lacks a concrete target component, threshold, owner, or due date.
- Deletion Test: Rewrite as a binary-verifiable ticket: which service, what threshold or test case, who owns it, and by what date.
```text
bad:  - [ ] 加强监控与告警。
trap: - [ ] 全面排查并持续跟进线上隐患。
good: - [ ] 给 `checkout-api` 增加 P99 > 400ms 持续 3 分钟告警并接入值班群（负责人：李工，11 月 30 日前完成）。
```

## Pack `regulated-comms` — External & Regulated Communications

Flags unsubstantiated absolute claims ('100% secure', 'zero risk') and floating hype multipliers ('10x faster' with no baseline) in external docs.

### `reg-unsubstantiated-superlative` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx, pptx)
- Why: Absolute or superlative claim creates legal/compliance exposure where scoped SLA terms belong.
- Deletion Test: Replace absolute promises with verifiable scope, encryption/audit standards, or contracted SLA numbers.
```text
bad:  新同城双活备份方案提供绝对安全与永久零故障保障（SLA 99.95%），客户迁移零风险承诺。
trap: 新同城双活备份方案打造坚不可摧的行业标杆级防线（SLA 99.95%）。
good: 新同城双活备份方案合同承诺月度可用性 99.95%，迁移前支持演练回滚。
```

### `reg-unanchored-multiplier` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx, pptx)
- Why: Floating speedup or efficiency multiplier ('10x faster') omits the before/after baseline.
- Deletion Test: Either add the exact baseline ('from 18s to 1.8s on 10M rows') or remove the multiplier.
```text
bad:  接入新版流式批处理引擎后，对账单导出效率提升数倍。
trap: 接入新版流式批处理引擎后，对账单导出迎来质的飞跃。
good: 接入新版流式批处理引擎后，对账单改为按块流式导出，无需等待全表缓存在内存。
```

## Pack `literary-essay` — Literary Essay & Longform Narrative

Protects concrete observation and voice against moralizing paragraph endings, second-order negation pivots, em-dash saturation, and half-width Chinese punctuation.

### `zh-essay-moralizing-ending` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx)
- Why: Moralizing summary formula flattens concrete scene observation at the end of a passage.
- Deletion Test: Cut the final moralizing sentence completely and stop on the concrete physical detail right before it.
```text
bad:  傍晚六点半，修表匠把拆下的三枚铜齿轮泡进煤油皿里，关掉台灯。这或许就是慢工出细活在喧嚣时代真正的意义所在。
trap: 傍晚六点半，三枚铜齿轮泡进煤油皿。这不是修表，而是与时间的对话。
good: 傍晚六点半，修表匠把拆下的三枚铜齿轮泡进煤油皿里，关掉台灯。
```

### `en-essay-moralizing-ending` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx)
- Why: Formulaic wistful conclusion tells the reader what to feel instead of ending on the scene.
- Deletion Test: Delete the concluding reflection; let the preceding image or quote carry the ending.
```text
bad:  At 6:15 a.m., the ferry deck smelled of wet rope and diesel. Ultimately, this reminds us that departures are always quieter than arrivals.
trap: Wet rope. Cold diesel. Quiet departures at 6:15 a.m.
good: At 6:15 a.m., the ferry deck smelled of wet rope and diesel.
```

### `literary-negation-pivot` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx)
- Why: Formulaic `Not X, but Y` / `不是 A，而是 B` aphorism interrupts narrative texture.
- Deletion Test: Replace the abstract contrast with what the person actually did, said, or noticed.
```text
bad:  老周留下的那把旧刨子不是工具，而是手艺人的尊严。
trap: 一把旧刨子。半生木工活。满手老茧。
good: 老周退休那天把用了二十年的旧刨子擦净木屑，收进樟木箱底。
```

### `excessive-em-dash-density` (taste / info / markdown, text, html, docx)
- Why: High em-dash (`—` / `——`) frequency creates breathless LLM parenthetical rhythm.
- Deletion Test: Convert most parenthetical dashes into commas or periods; save a single dash for a genuine turn.
```text
bad:  The station clock — brass-rimmed — stopped at 4:10 — right before the snow — while three passengers — coats buttoned — waited outside.
trap: Brass clock. 4:10 sharp. Snow falling. Three passengers waiting.
good: The brass-rimmed station clock stopped at 4:10, right before the snow, while three passengers waited outside in buttoned coats.
```

### `zh-halfwidth-punctuation` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx)
- Why: Half-width ASCII punctuation (`,;:!?`) wedged directly between Chinese characters.
- Deletion Test: Replace half-width ASCII punctuation between Han characters with full-width Chinese punctuation (`，；：！？`).
```text
bad:  冬至那天下了初雪,院子里的腊梅开了三朵;香气一直飘到走廊。
trap: 冬至初雪。腊梅三朵。暗香盈袖。
good: 冬至那天下了初雪，院子里的腊梅开了三朵；香气一直飘到走廊。
```

### `literary-semicolon-tricolon` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx)
- Why: Balanced three-part semicolon sentence turns scene description into synthetic lyrical cadence.
- Deletion Test: Break the three-part balance into natural prose sentences and keep the one sensory detail that carries the scene.
```text
bad:  街道两旁的树叶逐渐染上金黄；午后的阳光变得柔和而绵长；行人的衣领也悄然立了起来。
trap: 树叶金黄。阳光柔和。衣领立起。
good: 午后阳光柔和，街道两旁的树叶已经发黄，路过的行人把衣领立了起来。
```

### `literary-rhetorical-qa` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx)
- Why: Staged self-answered rhetorical question ('Why does ...? Because ...') lectures the reader instead of showing the scene.
- Deletion Test: Cut the rhetorical question and describe what actually happened in the scene.
```text
bad:  At 6:30 a.m. he brewed a cup of pour-over coffee. Why does brewing pour-over coffee feel so grounding? Because the deliberate pace invites us to pause.
trap: Warm water. Slow pour. Quiet pause.
good: At 6:30 a.m. he brewed a cup of pour-over coffee.
```

### `literary-narrative-frame` (taste / warning / markdown, text, html, docx)
- Why: Sweeping era opener ('In an era defined by...') or uplifting takeaway closer wraps a personal essay in an LLM template.
- Deletion Test: Delete the opening era backdrop and the closing takeaway; start directly inside the concrete time, place, or object.
```text
bad:  In an era defined by relentless notifications, the street stays quiet before seven except for the milk truck. Moving forward, protecting small pockets of stillness remains essential for living with intention.
trap: Notifications beep. Milk truck passes. Stillness stays.
good: Before seven the street stays quiet except for the milk truck.
```

## Pack `deck-and-ui` — Slide Deck, Web UI & Graphic Layout

Flags PowerPoint and PDF slide word-walls, autofit text shrink, generic titles, Web UI neon gradients, glow orbs, emoji chrome, icon-tile grids, SVG layout defects, and raster image AI workflow/palette slop.

### `slide-word-wall` (taste / warning / pptx, pdf)
- Why: Slide exceeds readable copy budget (> 120 Latin words or > 280 Chinese characters).
- Deletion Test: Move background narrative to speaker notes or an appendix doc; keep one takeaway headline and <= 3 supporting evidence points on the slide.
```text
bad:  Slide 3 packs 215 words of full-sentence prose explaining migration history, rollback scripts, staffing, and Q4 SLA targets.
trap: Slide 3 shrinks body font to 9pt so all 215 words fit inside one rounded box.
good: Slide 3 headline: 'Zero-downtime migration cut p99 latency from 420 ms to 95 ms' + 3 short metric rows (54 words total); full runbook linked in notes.
```

### `slide-bullet-overload` (taste / warning / pptx)
- Why: Slide contains more than 6 bullet items (`maxSlideBullets`), fragmenting visual hierarchy.
- Deletion Test: Group related bullets into 2–3 structured columns or split across two slides.
```text
bad:  Slide lists 9 separate top-level bullets covering pricing, onboarding, compliance, SLA, and billing.
trap: Slide wraps 9 bullets into 9 tiny pill badges.
good: Slide groups commercial terms into 3 columns: Pricing ($49/seat), Onboarding (2 days), SLA (99.95%).
```

### `slide-autofit-shrink` (taste / warning / pptx)
- Why: PowerPoint `normAutofit` shrank text below 80% (`fontScale < 80000`) because copy overflowed its box.
- Deletion Test: Trim the overflowing copy or enlarge the text frame so body type renders at 100% scale.
```text
bad:  <a:normAutofit fontScale="62500" lnSpcReduction="20000"/> on body placeholder
trap: Manually hardcode 10pt font so `normAutofit` disappears while text stays illegible.
good: <a:noAutofit/> with 42 words set at 18pt and full line spacing
```

### `slide-weak-topic-title` (taste / info / pptx)
- Why: Content-heavy slide uses a generic topic label (`Overview`, `Background`, `背景`) instead of stating its takeaway.
- Deletion Test: Replace `Overview` with the one-sentence finding the audience should remember from this slide.
```text
bad:  Title: 'Background' (above 65 words detailing 38% cart abandonment on mobile Safari)
trap: Title: 'Reimagining Checkout Excellence'
good: Title: 'Mobile Safari accounts for 38% of cart abandonment due to 4-step address entry'
```

### `ui-ai-gradient` (taste / warning / html, css, jsx, svg, pdf)
- Why: Default purple/indigo-to-pink generator gradient or gradient-clipped display headline.
- Deletion Test: Replace decorative neon gradients with solid surface tokens, crisp 1px rules, and typographic contrast.
```text
bad:  <h1 class="bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 via-purple-500 to-pink-500 bg-clip-text text-transparent">Release Notes v2.4</h1>
trap: <h1 class="bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-400 to-cyan-500 bg-clip-text text-transparent">Release Notes v2.4</h1>
good: <h1 class="page-title">Release Notes v2.4</h1>
```

### `ui-pill-soup` (taste / warning / html, jsx)
- Why: Excessive `rounded-full` / `999px` text pills (> 6 per view) turn interface metadata into badge soup.
- Deletion Test: Render metadata as plain tabular text separated by middots (`·`) or hairlines; save one high-contrast label for actionable status.
```text
bad:  8 adjacent `rounded-full` badges on one card: `Active`, `v2.4`, `US-West`, `SOC2`, `Fast`, `AI`, `Pro`, `Verified`.
trap: 8 square pastel badges with 8 emoji icons on one card.
good: Plain mono metadata line: `v2.4 · us-west-2 · SOC2` + single status word `degraded` when unhealthy.
```

### `ui-box-in-box` (taste / warning / html, jsx)
- Why: Three or more nested bordered/rounded containers wrap the same content (`box-in-box-in-box`).
- Deletion Test: Remove outer wrapper borders and separate sections with alignment, whitespace, or a single 1px rule.
```text
bad:  <div class="border rounded-xl p-6"><div class="border rounded-lg p-4"><div class="border rounded-md p-3">99.98% uptime</div></div></div>
trap: <div class="shadow-xl rounded-2xl p-6"><div class="shadow-md rounded-xl p-4"><div class="bg-slate-900 rounded-lg p-3">99.98% uptime</div></div></div>
good: <section class="metric-row"><span>Uptime (90d)</span><strong>99.98%</strong></section>
```

### `ui-prompt-echo-badge` (taste / warning / html, jsx, svg)
- Why: Interface chrome echoes prompt-engineering hype (`AI-Powered`, `Zero Hallucination`) instead of naming the function.
- Deletion Test: Delete the `AI-Powered` badge; label the control by the exact task it performs ('Extract invoice totals', 'Check slide word count').
```text
bad:  <span class="eyebrow">AI-Powered · Zero Hallucination</span><h2>Document Checker</h2>
trap: <span class="eyebrow">Built for Craft · Pure Signal</span><h2>Document Checker</h2>
good: <h2>Document Linter for Markdown, HTML, DOCX & PPTX</h2>
```

### `ui-glow-blob-chrome` (taste / warning / html, css, jsx, svg)
- Why: Decorative ambient blur orbs (`blur-3xl`), neon box-shadows, pulsing `animate-ping` pill dots, or heavy SVG glow filters.
- Deletion Test: Delete decorative blur orbs and colored glow shadows; separate layers with solid surface tokens and crisp 1px borders.
```text
bad:  <div class="blur-3xl rounded-full bg-purple-500/30"></div><button class="shadow-indigo-500/50">Launch</button>
trap: <div class="blur-3xl rounded-full bg-amber-500/20"></div><button class="shadow-teal-500/50">Launch</button>
good: <section class="surface-sheet border"><button class="btn-primary">Launch</button></section>
```

### `ui-emoji-icon-chrome` (taste / warning / html, jsx, svg)
- Why: Three or more decorative AI stock emojis (`🚀`, `✨`, `⚡`, `🛡️`) used as interface or heading icons.
- Deletion Test: Strip decorative emojis from headings and controls; use plain typography or a consistent single-stroke SVG icon set.
```text
bad:  <h3>🚀 Fast</h3><h3>⚡ Sync</h3><h3>🛡️ Safe</h3>
trap: <h3>🌟 Fast</h3><h3>💎 Sync</h3><h3>🎯 Safe</h3>
good: <h3>Sub-50 ms checks</h3><h3>Local sync</h3><h3>Offline by default</h3>
```

### `ui-template-card-grid` (taste / warning / html, jsx)
- Why: Stock generator UI boilerplate: tinted rounded-square icon tiles (>= 3), fake macOS 3-dot window chrome, or sequential `01`/`02`/`03` eyebrow kickers.
- Deletion Test: Remove fake window dots, sequential numeric kickers, and tinted icon tiles; organize cards with real headings and alignment.
```text
bad:  <div class="rounded-xl w-10 h-10 bg-indigo-50">A</div><div class="rounded-xl w-10 h-10 bg-purple-50">B</div><div class="rounded-xl w-10 h-10 bg-pink-50">C</div>
trap: <div><span>01</span><h3>Speed</h3><span>02</span><h3>Scale</h3><span>03</span><h3>Trust</h3></div>
good: <section class="grid"><div><h3>CLI</h3><p>Checks Markdown and PPTX locally.</p></div><div><h3>MCP</h3><p>Connects to coding agents.</p></div></section>
```

### `svg-layout-slop` (taste / warning / svg)
- Why: SVG graphic has structural generation defects: missing `viewBox` on a large canvas, overlapping `<text>` coordinates, or >= 2 orphaned `<defs>` entries.
- Deletion Test: Add an explicit `viewBox`, separate `<text>` coordinates cleanly, and delete unused gradients or filters from `<defs>`.
```text
bad:  <svg width="640" height="360"><text x="40" y="50">Step 1</text><text x="42" y="52">Overlap</text></svg>
trap: <svg viewBox="0 0 640 360" width="640" height="360"><defs><linearGradient id="u1"/><linearGradient id="u2"/></defs><rect width="640" height="360"/></svg>
good: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" width="640" height="360"><text x="40" y="50">Step 1</text><text x="40" y="96">Step 2</text></svg>
```

### `image-ai-workflow-residue` (taste / warning / image)
- Why: Raster image embeds unstripped AI generation prompt/workflow parameters (warning) or explicit synthetic provenance tags (info — retain required legal disclosures).
- Deletion Test: Strip accidental raw prompt/seed workflow JSON before shipping assets; keep legally required C2PA or IPTC `trainedAlgorithmicMedia` disclosures intact.
```text
bad:  PNG tEXt chunk `parameters`: `masterpiece, neon glow\nNegative prompt: blurry\nSteps: 28, Sampler: Euler a, CFG scale: 7`
trap: Stripping legal C2PA / `trainedAlgorithmicMedia` provenance tags instead of inspecting or re-shooting the asset
good: Clean PNG/JPEG export with raw prompt/node-graph chunks removed and natural photographic or editorial raster assets
```

### `image-ai-palette-slop` (taste / info / image)
- Why: PNG pixel profile matches default AI-slop aesthetics: dominant neon purple-indigo-pink palette or hyper-saturated airbrushed plastic sheen.
- Deletion Test: Review the rendered image for plastic skin/surfaces or generic neon-purple backdrops; re-grade toward natural micro-contrast and restrained accents.
```text
bad:  1024x1024 dark-mode hero PNG with 42% #0B0B14 dark backdrop and 28% glowing #7C3AED/#EC4899 purple-pink pixels
trap: 1024x1024 PNG pushing every surface to 92% saturation with airbrushed zero-texture gradients
good: 1024x1024 PNG on #F6F7F5 paper ground with crisp ink typography and <= 5% single vermilion accent
```

### `pdf-visual-layout-slop` (taste / warning / pdf)
- Why: PDF slide/poster layout exhibits synthetic template defects: multi-page raster-only slides, collapsed font hierarchy, crushed < 9.5pt body copy, or 4+ consecutive identical landscape slide skeletons.
- Deletion Test: Export slides with selectable vector text, restore a >= 1.2x title-to-body type scale, keep body type >= 11pt, and vary layout structure across slides.
```text
bad:  4-page landscape 960x540 PDF deck where every slide is a single rasterized PNG image with 0 selectable text operators
trap: 4-page landscape PDF deck shrinking all body text to 8.5pt with 10pt titles (1.17x ratio) to cram paragraphs
good: 5-page landscape PDF deck with 28pt assertion headlines, 13pt body copy, and alternating tables and charts
```

## Pack `executive-deck` — Executive Slide Deck & Board Readout

Enforces conclusion-first slide headlines and flags monotonous multi-slide bullet skeletons on top of core deck and UI hygiene.

### `slide-process-not-finding-title` (taste / warning / markdown, pptx)
- Why: Topic-label headline names the work done ('Analysis of X') instead of stating the finding.
- Deletion Test: Replace 'Analysis of X' with the one-sentence answer your audience should remember if they read only the headline.
```text
bad:  ## 关于三季度新客首周流失率（34% 降至 19%）的分析汇报
trap: ## 重塑新客留存增长飞轮
good: ## 三季度新客首周流失率从 34% 降至 19%
```

### `pptx-layout-monotony` (taste / info / pptx)
- Why: Four or more consecutive slides repeat the exact same plain text-box skeleton without tables, charts, or visual variation.
- Deletion Test: Convert comparative bullet slides into a structured table, timeline, or metric chart to break monotonous pacing.
```text
bad:  Slides 2–5 all use identical 'Title + 4 plain bullets' boxes with zero tables, charts, or diagrams.
trap: Slides 2–5 keep the exact same 4 bullets per slide and add decorative stock icons.
good: Slide 3 presents regional latency in a 4-row table and Slide 4 plots weekly error budget burn.
```
